reviews.headline: Great toner!
reviews.comment: I really enjoy the way these toner pads feel. I've been using them for about two weeks now and they're my first step after I cleanse my face. They leave my face feeling cleansed and fresh and ready for all my moisturizing products. I feel like you also get a great amount of them for how much you're paying.

reviews.headline: Fantastic!
reviews.comment: These pads glide so smoothly over my skin and leave my skin glowing and refreshed. I leave the pad under my eyes or anywhere i need extra moisture. This is also a great mask when applying pads on your face and leaving them for 20 minites.

reviews.headline: Not the worst
reviews.comment: Its not bad but i dont think it would work well for oily skin type. The pads stick tocether and you have to pull it apart.

reviews.headline: 5-Star Review
reviews.comment: Amaze, skin is already improving. Much easier than whole face masks, but works just as good.
